items.source: Configuration interface exposing common client configuration properties for Elasticsearch clients.
items.translation: 配置接口，用于暴露 Elasticsearch 客户端的通用客户端配置属性。

items.source: Callback to be executed to configure a client.
items.translation: 用于配置客户端的回调。

items.source:
This package contains classes that use the new Elasticsearch client library (co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java)
to access Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 本包包含使用新的 Elasticsearch 客户端库（co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java）来访问 Elasticsearch 的类。

items.source: This package contains related to the new (from Elasticsearch 9 on) Rest5Client.
items.translation: 此包包含与新版（从 Elasticsearch 9 开始）Rest5Client 相关的内容。

items.source: This package contains related to the old (up to Elasticsearch 9) RestClient.
items.translation: 该包包含与旧版（最高至 Elasticsearch 9）RestClient 相关的内容。

items.source: Value Object containing information about Elasticsearch cluster nodes.
items.translation: 包含有关 Elasticsearch 集群节点信息的值对象。
